text_block_list.text:
Мэдзиро МакКуин's attempt in the Kobe
Shimbun
Hai ends in success.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Her next challenge is the Kikuka Sho,
the final
race of the Classics. Winning
this one is necessary
if she's to go on
and participate in the Tenno Sho.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Мэдзиро Райан is likely to be running as
well. The
thought of a showdown against
her big sister fills
Мэдзиро МакКуин with
vigor.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
